svg.title: 03 · PostgreSQL 18 Multi-Schema Physical DB & Merge Integrity — iqoqo v1.2.0
svg.desc: Physical ER and schema boundary diagram for PostgreSQL 18 in iqoqo v1.2.0 showing all 7 schemas (auth, catalog, inventory, social, dedicated federation, config, public) and the frbr_merge.py consolidation map (20 Work, 8 Expression, 10 Manifestation ref-points).
svg.text: 03 · PostgreSQL 18 Multi-Schema Physical DB & Merge Integrity
Blueprint 3 of 12 • 7 Schemas (auth, catalog, inventory, social, federation, config, public), GIN FTS & frbr_merge.py

g.text: Immutable-by-default shared catalog decoupled from tenant inventory copies
Cleanly isolated from social tickets in v1.2.0
Row keys masked in Admin UI
• Re-points BOTH ON DELETE CASCADE & SET NULL
• Collapses natural-key unique collisions onto survivor
• Row-level SQL DELETE (never ORM cascade wipeout)
Retired Work IRI emits ActivityStreams Tombstone
& HTTP 301 permanent redirect to surviving Work
Fails build if any new FK column is unmapped
Single Shared Map: Manual Merge + Duplicate Queue

svg.text: v1.2.0 New Table / Schema / Merge Update
